headline: Full Stack Developer | Node.js | React.js
summary: Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience building web applications using Node.js, Express.js, React.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Experienced in REST API design, background job processing, and automated deployments. Works in Agile teams and ships production-ready features end to end.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer

Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time from 40 to 12 minutes.
